title: Classify castle roof degenerates and exterior opening probe warnings
description:
EVIDENCE
The final INT-007 required cnormals run passed 84 checks with 0 failures, 169 warnings and native exit 0: artifacts/int007_cnormals_split.log, artifacts/int007_cnormals_split.exit.txt. Its stderr is empty. The 169 occurrences span 54 fixtures: 75 hall, 60 keep and 6 tower outside-probe warnings; 28 roof-surface warnings each report two degenerate triangles (56 triangles total). Read the complete fixture/seed/count table and reproduction recipe in docs/CASTLE_INTERIOR_WARNINGS.md#castle-normals-warnings-from-the-final-required-sweep. These are warnings to classify, not 169 established independent defects.

RULE BRANCHES AND SOURCE ENTRY POINTS
1. tests/suites/normals_suite.gd::check_openings considers kind=window parts with horizontal facing near a mass, probes pos +/- 0.35m along that facing, and tests mass AABBs shrunk by 0.06m. _in_solid excludes a mass containing both probes from the exterior blocker test. The warning branch is behind && ahead, which still counts as correctly facing. This is NOT emitted-triangle occlusion. A hollow/curved/tapered mass envelope can produce the warning; a real neighboring range, curtain or tower can too. Neither explanation is established by the log alone. Preserve failures for wrong-facing or unsupported openings.
2. NormalsSuite.check_mesh computes (c-a).cross(b-a).length(); values below MIN_AREA=1e-6 (twice triangle area) are counted as degenerate and excluded from winding ratios. All 28 warnings are surface2, CastleBuilder.SURF_ROOF. Dump actual indexed triangles before attributing them to a producer. Investigate src/castle/castle_builder.gd::_join_roofs and roof emitters plus core/mesh_kit.gd::slab_poly; the offending emitter is not yet established.

EXACT STARTING FIXTURES
- norman/manor/0, seed9074, 14x24x8m: two hall outside-probe warnings.
- norman/castle/0, seed9249, 40x55x14m: one keep outside-probe warning and two degenerate roof triangles.
- edwardian/fortress/0, seed9117, 90x140x20m: four tower and two keep outside-probe warnings.
- japanese/castle/0, seed9249, 40x55x14m: two degenerate roof triangles with no outside-probe warning, useful to separate the categories.
Use CastleSweep.spec_at(style,tier,index), then CastleBuilder.build. Call BOTH NormalsSuite.check_mesh and check_openings exactly as CastleNormalsSuite.run does. The complete 54-fixture inventory and all dimensions/seed mapping are in the linked handoff and CastleSweep.SIZES. Full reproduction is the AGENTS.md Godot executable with --headless --path . --script res://tests/run_all.gd -- cnormals. Recorded elapsed915.74s was concurrent, not an isolated benchmark.

IMPLEMENTATION / DIAGNOSTICS
For every starting blocked-opening fixture identify the matching builder.part_log entry by tag, position and facing, retain planned_opening metadata, and print names/AABBs for every mass containing each probe. Inspect actual triangles intersecting the aperture/exterior ray and render the opening before deciding between a placement/emission fix and a tighter probe. For degenerates record exact surface/triangle indices and vertices, then trace the producing cap/clip/roof primitive; retain deliberate shared boundaries and shell thickness. Do not blanket-remove all small seams or skip logged planned openings.

OWNERSHIP
CASTLE-INTERIOR-WARNINGS (8e41759c-ef3f-4b57-9910-3c32078f25de) owns the separate seven placement/navigation categories. This task is structural QA/roof emission. Existing pending ROOF-AUDIT-002 (3ef49d68-b9f9-4836-b0cb-c299cc4046ef) owns church/temple duplicate seams and degenerates; coordinate shared MeshKit or roof-probe changes, and preserve or resolve its distinct fixtures. WaterFree searches for 'walled in' and 'blocked opening' found no existing task on 2026-09-13. Re-check task ownership before implementation.
aiNotes: Registered after root review on 2026-09-13. All 169 normals warnings across 54 fixtures are documented in docs/CASTLE_INTERIOR_WARNINGS.md. Coordinate roof seam changes with ROOF-AUDIT-002; preserve independent geometric evidence and the passing required suites.
acceptanceCriteria:
- Record fixture-level dispositions for all 169 warning occurrences (75 hall, 60 keep, 6 tower, 28 degenerate groups) with mass/probe evidence or actual indexed mesh vertices. Update docs/CASTLE_INTERIOR_WARNINGS.md with exact remaining counts; zero warnings is not an acceptance shortcut.
- Confirmed opaque obstructions are corrected in opening placement/emission while preserving required lighting, actual wall alignment and courtyard constraints. Any probe refinement distinguishes a hollow/curved AABB false positive from an actual opaque blocker using independent triangle geometry; negative controls for reversed, unsupported and physically filled openings still fail.
- Trace and remove confirmed degenerate roof faces at their producer without losing roof thickness, outward winding, side closure or legitimate shared seams. Include indexed-vertex and zero-area controls at the responsible primitive boundary.
- Coordinate shared roof work with ROOF-AUDIT-002 and preserve its church/temple regression fixtures. Do not absorb the unrelated chapel/stable/affinity placement task.
- Run relevant focused regressions and the required castle cnormals cmassing clandmark cvoxelqa suites after implementation; retain zero failures and report all remaining warnings honestly. Render affected fixtures with roofs on and off.
